notes: One permit per house; Units 1 on most new permits, 0 on about a third (2001-2026)
Builder model home: a house like any other
Units 2 on most new duplex permits (1,675 of 2,064); Units 1-2 taken as reported (1 = one permit per half); 0 or missing -> 2
Foundation-only permit ahead of the building permit: 0 units
Group home (Texas Community Homes for Disabled Persons Location Act): units unknown
Apartment building: type and units from Units when it is 2 or more
Rental townhouse building: type and units from Units when it is 2 or more
Detached cottage in a rental community (build-to-rent): Units 1 is a one-unit building (SFD, as BPS counts it); 2+ as Apartment
Sheds, garages, carports, pools, fences and the 'Accessory Dwelling' use (which also holds storm shelters, studios and game rooms): 0 units unless the description parser names an ADU
